early_death.outcome: Death within 60 days of treatment start
early_death.intended_use: Decision support: prompts review by an authorised programme or clinical user. Not a diagnosis, and never an automatic trigger for treatment or programme decisions.
limitations: Trained on synthetic data in this repository. Performance figures describe the pipeline, not real patients.
Associations are not causes. Reasons shown are factors the model links with higher risk.
Missing HIV, BMI or diabetes data lowers accuracy; missing values are shown as their own reasons.
Performance must be re-validated on the pilot districts' own retrospective data before live use.
early_death.reasons_method: Odds ratios of the transparent logistic model; top three risk-raising factors that apply to the patient.
